snippet.title: Coach Evan Got EJECTED After This Game! (BATTLE FLAG PHOENIX)
snippet.description:
The GOAL of this youth channel has always been to give youth athletes a platform to showcase their talents & show their development growing up learning the game. Five Stars receive more coverage than others because they welcomed us & gave us the access to tell their story. But at the end of the day, we ALWAYS support & show love to everybody who balls out and makes plays. I always believed that the Rebels saw this & appreciated us, but I was wrong. When the moment gets too big, stop looking at us to blame. We don't call any plays & we do not officiate any games. 

Every view, like, comment & subscriber is going to help me give back to youth sports!
